units.reason: New unexported function type with no runtime logic; behavior lives in compactHeadViewLocked and its callers.
units.headline: Add unexported headViewFactory type for restricted head views
units.summary: Declares an unexported function type that compactHeadViewLocked uses to build a per-chunk-range BlockReader over a subset of head series. The type itself executes nothing; its doc matches the caller, which invokes it once per slice with the inclusive range [mint, mint+chunkRange-1].

units.reason: New unexported function type with documentation only; eviction logic is in truncateStaleSeries/truncateSelectedSeries, reviewed elsewhere.
units.headline: Add unexported headSeriesEvictor type with append-ID watermark contract
units.summary: Declares the evictor callback signature (maxt, appendIDWatermark) that compactHeadViewLocked calls after writing blocks, and documents that series with samples newer than the watermark must be kept. The declaration carries no logic; the claim that the watermark is always 0 with isolation disabled depends on committedAppendID and the appender, which are not in this unit and could not be shown to break it.
